name: 964 central carbon cell, F1 assumption-only study
description: Editable clean-sheet central-tub concept with floor regions, sills, a driveline service tunnel, bulkheads and seat-crossmember load paths. Geometry, interfaces, material properties and loads are declared design hypotheses; this is not a reconstruction of the donor or a copy of a commercial monocoque.

classification.intended_use: Hypothesis-only architecture, editable geometry and conditional torsion/bending studies; no vehicle fitment, manufacture or road/track release

provenance.record_license: Repository LICENSE for independently authored study geometry and code; no source scan, proprietary manual, vendor photograph or commercial CAD reused

sources.title: Owner-authorized assumption-only central-cell study
sources.license: Repository LICENSE for the independent study
sources.notes: The owner explicitly requested continuing with hypotheses. The new study does not alter frozen donor evidence, restore withdrawn geometry or establish measured interfaces. Model-year bounds describe study scope only.

material.family: assumed carbon-fibre/epoxy composite for elastic screening
material.grade: undecided; no supplier-certified laminate or core allowables
material.standard: undecided; no process or road/track qualification

supplier_requirements: Measured functional interfaces and an independently accepted load path before functional part design or tooling commitment.
Traceable laminate, core, adhesive and insert properties, process definition, coupons, inspection and professional validation plan.

titanium.galvanic_isolation: Any later metallic inserts require their own material, attachment and isolation qualification.

known_limits: All new dimensions, attachment positions and service envelopes are design assumptions, not Porsche or donor measurements.
The source frame is a local study frame; no donor registration, dimensional accuracy or physical side correspondence is admitted.
The Carrera 2 scope does not establish donor model year or gearbox, and supplies no 993 or Carrera 4 compatibility evidence.
The current open-top tub omits windshield, door and roof load paths; it is not a complete enclosed central cell.
Fixture/load-introduction regions are hypothetical; calculated stiffness applies only to the declared model and boundary conditions.
Conditional elastic results do not establish laminate strength, joint capacity, fatigue, buckling, crash, occupant-restraint, fire or aging performance.
No measured material/process allowables, mould qualification, physical correlation or manufacturing/road/track approval is supplied.
Historical rejected whole-body geometry and its renders remain withdrawn as the product baseline; their results do not transfer to this study.
This concept is not a released functional part or a validated final digital twin.
